titre: Réti gives his queen. Can Black stop the mate? ♟️ #chess #shorts
description:
Réti – Tartakower, Vienna 1910 (Edward Winter, chesshistory.com). After 8...Nxe4, White mates in 3: 9.Qd8+!! Kxd8 10.Bg5+ (double check) Kc7 11.Bd8#. Checked with Stockfish 16. Would you have sacrificed your queen? 👇
